latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of sales-comp-redesign-coach skill.
- Helps B2B SaaS sales leaders diagnose, redesign, and roll out improved sales compensation plans when current structures are misaligned or overly complex.
- Covers diagnosis of misaligned behaviors, comp plan structure (base/variable mix, OTE benchmarks, accelerators/decelerators), metric design, role-specific comp, SPIFF/bonus practices, territory and quota assignment, rollout timing/communication, and legal/tax mechanics.
- Designed to address common failure modes such as over-engineering, mid-year changes, and lack of rep feedback.
- Triggers on common sales comp redesign phrases and guides through practical, step-by-step process.
